device.type: DVB-S2 HD single-tuner satellite receiver with Conax Smart HD+ card reader and CI slot
device.soc: ALi M3606 (the main-code chunk's version "M3606 ", the seecode chunk's "M3606 SEE"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build, SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py), matched by the main-code chunk's version; chip ID 0x3603 (chipId)

image.version: 1.3.4 RC3 PL SMART HD+ (main-code chunk 100000002003004 "M3606 "; bootloader << SDK4.0ba.4.2_20110225 >>; Libcore 8.33.0@SDK4.0ba.8.33_20150107, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo_20120530, HDMI_ALI_E_141022_1; the SEE's uLibcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126)
image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.1.0), HDCPKey 0x01FE00 (1.0.1), maincode 0x020000 (chunk "100000002003004" M3606 , LZMA 0x111805 bytes -> 5.5 MB), seecode 0x180000 (M3606 SEE, LZMA 0xBE8AB -> 2.3 MB), Radioback 0x280000 (1.0.0), ca 0x28FF80 (00000001), defaultdb 0x2A0000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x2BFF80 (1.0.0, 0x140070 bytes) -- the whole 4 MB flash

source.note: The manufacturer's USB update software_conax_x110p_pl_smart_hd-_1-3-4_2015_01_23.original.zip; fetched 2026-10-18 from the mirror's Opticum / Opticum HD X110p folder.

simulator.note: Its bootloader chunk header sets byte 0x43 = 0x80 (the EuP standby-on-AC-power-up flag: on a cold reset with $fp == 0, 0xAFC00694 writes 0xDEAD3BEE to 0xA0000110 and the bootloader enters its flash standby loop at 0x8FC012C4..0x8FC01368 until the front-panel power key KI2/DIG4 sets $fp = 0xDEADBEAD and jumps back to 0xAFC00000).  With $fp = 0xDEADBEAD set by M3602.start() when rom_image[0x43] == 0x80 (chips/m3602.py), it boots straight into the application, starts the SEE program at 0xA6000200, tunes its preloaded channel 48 (panel " ON ", "  48") and draws the channel banner (~330k non-background pixels at 80 M instructions) followed by the "No Signal!" box.  Its remote uses standard NEC ("nec", MENU 0x37FD).

desc: The official 1.3.4 RC3 Polish Conax Smart HD+ update (2015-01-23) of the Opticum HD X110p satellite receiver: the single-tuner sister model of the Opticum X110TS on the ALi M3606 SoC (main-code chunk 100000002003004, version "M3606 ") with the same TM1650-compatible front panel on GPIO 9 (SCL) / 8 (SDA) and the same LNB / tuner fault inputs on GPIO 99 / 104.

Built on Libcore 8.33.0 (2015-01-07) and the SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo application line, with a ca chunk at 0x28FF80 for the Conax Smart HD+ card reader and a preloaded Polish Hotbird channel list starting on channel 48.
